reasons: The candidate applies the constant 100 twice, but the Datadog source has no numeric constant. The percent-to-ratio scale is a unit caveat to put in notes, not in promql, so the expression does not compute the same unit as system.cpu.iowait (%).

The OTel metric system.cpu.time is a monotonic sum in seconds. rate() gives a per-CPU fraction in ratio units, so a single percent scale would be needed for the Datadog percent unit. The candidate's scaling is wrong either way.
The candidate uses host_name in the grouping, but observed dataset labels for system.cpu.time do not include host_name, so the grouping cannot be confirmed against the dataset labels.

The candidate's aggregation (max over per-host averages) matches the ungrouped max across hosts in the Datadog query, and the template variable $scope without a prefix is correctly dropped, so those parts are ok.
